question: We activated an annual Enterprise subscription 10 days ago and used 40 computing hours. We are submitting a written refund request today for the subscription, custom onboarding, and data migration engineering. Which charges qualify under the policy, and how are approved refunds returned?
single_query: We activated an annual Enterprise subscription 10 days ago and used 40 computing hours. We are submitting a written refund request today for the subscription, custom onboarding, and data migration engineering. Which charges qualify under the policy, and how are approved refunds returned?

decomposed_queries.query: What written request deadline and compute usage limit govern annual subscription refunds?
Are onboarding and data migration professional fees refundable?
How are approved refunds returned and how long does processing take?
